test-code.description: good: not-null assertion (!!) on a volatile field is not an increment
bad: prefix decrement and increment of a volatile field
good: local variable shadows the volatile field name
good: parameter-like local loop counter with the same name as the field
bad: volatile field of outer class incremented in nested class
bad: volatile top-level-in-class field incremented from lambda
bad: compound assignment on volatile field, plain and via this
good: compound assignment and increment on the same-named property of another object
